verdict.rationale: Gemini is itself an AI assistant, and its docs show task delegation. With permission it takes actions like editing and managing content in connected apps. It also runs scheduled recurring actions, conducts Deep Research across chosen sources, and can be invoked from Android and the Mac desktop. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of delegated task execution, and deeper documentation of how far action-taking goes and how autonomous it is (e.g. Connected Apps are not available in Google Messages).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: With your permission, Gemini can also help you take actions, like editing and managing your content in other apps.
Summarize emails from Gmail, create events in Google Calendar or third-party apps, or search for content across a variety of productivity apps.
You can make Gemini a part of your daily, weekly, and monthly routines by scheduling recurring actions.
You can conduct in-depth and real-time research on almost any subject with Deep Research in Gemini Apps.
You can interact with Gemini, Google's AI assistant, directly from your Mac desktop.
